# The valley road: banks, the gaps' floors and back walls, anchor plates, the hill (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Grass --base-color 0.318 0.420 0.263 --no-slot
material new Dust --base-color 0.600 0.522 0.475 --no-slot
material new Rock --base-color 0.475 0.424 0.392 --no-slot

material new Hill --base-color 0.443 0.510 0.271 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Front0 --size 1 --location -8.500 -1.000 -3.250
scale 11.000 0.400 6.500
apply --scale
material assign Rock
active Front0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5 || normal.y > 0.5 || abs(normal.x) > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Front0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
material assign Grass
mode object
